title: feat(search): add fuzzy search matching
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Add opt-in fuzzy matching support to `@floatboat/nexus-plugin-search` helper APIs.

## Motivation / 背景与动机

- Issue: N/A
- Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md): Search / Commands #17 fuzzy search
- OpenSpec change: N/A, roadmap marks this item as not requiring OpenSpec

## Changes / 变更内容

- `packages/plugin-search`:
  - Add `fuzzy?: boolean` to `SearchOptions`.
  - Add fuzzy matching for `findSearchMatches()` when `fuzzy` is enabled.
  - Keep existing literal and regexp search behavior unchanged by default.
  - Add Vitest coverage for fuzzy, case-sensitive fuzzy, opt-in behavior, and regexp precedence.

## Testing / 测试

- [x] `pnpm test` passes / 全绿
- [x] Affected packages build (`pnpm build`) / 受影响包构建通过
- [x] New / updated vitest cases / 新增或更新的 vitest 用例：
  - fuzzy matching
  - case-sensitive fuzzy matching
  - fuzzy remains opt-in
  - regexp search ignores fuzzy mode
- [ ] Manual UI check in electron-demo / electron-demo 手动验证：N/A, helper-only change

## Compliance / 合规自检

- [ ] **CLA signed** — first-time contributors will be prompted automatically by the CLA bot
- [x] **AI disclosure**: AI assistance was used to implement the helper logic and tests under contributor direction.
- [x] **New dependencies**: none
- [x] **No build artifacts** committed
- [x] **No secrets** / `.env` / personal vault data committed

## Checklist / 自检清单

- [x] Title follows Conventional Commits
- [x] Public API changes update package README / types — types updated; this package has no README
- [x] Touched `live-preview-table.ts` → N/A
- [x] New capability / breaking change → OpenSpec proposal linked — N/A per roadmap
- [x] Change aligns with project scope
